notes: B-57 (2026-10-29): Subira's '{1}{R}, {T}, Discard your hand: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control with power 2 or less deals combat damage to a PLAYER, draw a card.' Subira enters (haste), pays the ability (discarding the one Spare card in hand; the engine refuses 'discard your hand' with an EMPTY hand, a separate weaker-than-printed cost bug), then two qualifying creatures attack: the Scout (2/2) is blocked by a 0/9 wall, the Runner (1/1) is unblocked. Only the Runner deals combat damage to a player, so the delayed trigger draws exactly ONE card. Before the fix its recipient filter was universal and the Scout's damage to the wall drew a second card.
